Repository files were read only; copied tests and artifacts are confined to this directory. No external network was used.

## Frozen inputs

- Common flags: `-std=c++23 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic`. No native CPU tuning.
- Checked and `-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS` configurations.
- Portable configuration adds `-U__SIZEOF_INT128__ -DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD`. The baseline has no __int128/SIMD branch; its GCC realloc-backed storage and Clang vector storage are both exercised.
- Sanitizer configuration uses `-O1 -g0 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer`; `ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0`, `UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1`.
- Per compile CPU limit 10 seconds, per run CPU limit 2 seconds; outer subprocess wall limit 60 seconds. Two workers.
- Tests define `LI_CHAO_SOURCE` as the absolute frozen baseline. Every successful compile dependency file includes frozen baseline and excludes repository source.
- Main link wrapper: `-Wl,--wrap=malloc,--wrap=realloc`; allocation test additionally wraps free. No failure-test or ownership checks were disabled.
